services.desc: Looking for an exciting way to cool off and enjoy the beautiful Texas Hill Country? Shanty Tubes offers unforgettable tubing adventures on the Guadalupe River. Whether you're in the mood for a leisurely float or an action-packed journey, we've got you covered. Our range of services includes: Ready to make a splash? Get in touch with Shanty Tubes and let's plan your perfect river day! Tubing offers a unique blend of relaxation and excitement that's perfect for beating the Texas heat. At Shanty Tubes, we ensure your comfort and enjoyment throughout your journey on the Guadalupe River. Don't miss out on the fun - contact Shanty Tubes to book your tubing adventure

services.desc: At Shanty Tubes, the adventure starts before you hit the water. Whether you're tubing, camping, or just soaking in the sun, we've got your transportation covered within a 15-mile radius of our Canyon Lake location.
